According to the August 2015 RWD, the WWTF upgrades will include: ... a flocculation tank...; From Diversion Box No. 5, the wastewater will be pumped to a flocculation tank followed by a suspended air flotation unit.

From Diversion Box No. 5, the wastewater will be pumped to a flocculation tank followed by a suspended air flotation unit. ... surfactant is added in the suspended air flotation unit.
The wastewater then flows by gravity to three dual-media filters operated in parallel. ... According to the August 2015 RWD, the WWTF upgrades will include: ... granular media filter...
According to the August 2015 RWD, the WWTF upgrades will include: ... storage tank for filter backwash, ... Filter effluent flows by gravity to a storage tank

According to the August 2015 RWD, the WWTF upgrades will include: ... a second chlorine contact tank. ... Filter effluent flows by gravity to a storage tank and then to two six-pass serpentine chlorine contact tanks operated in series. Sodium Hypochlorite is injected at the beginning of the first chlorine contact tank.
According to the RWD, sludge produced from the WWTF will be dewatered in geotextiles tubes installed inside roll-off bins.
Then the geotextile tube(s) and solids will be dumped as a unit in a landfill.
